# Kuwait Computer Repair On Call (KCROC)
Expert Component-Level Repair Service in Kuwait.

## Business Information
We specialize in component-level micro-soldering and logic board repairs for laptops, MacBooks, and gaming PCs. We offer a Free Computer Diagnostic and Free Pick-up & Delivery across all of Kuwait.
